classes.name: Obtain embeddings
classes.boundary: Synchronous SDK request: provider work, network and provider waiting together. Local preparation and file writing are outside this timer.
classes.opportunity: Keep vectors for unchanged inputs. A new issue needs its own vector, not new vectors for every source file.

classes.name: Read source into facts
classes.boundary: Whole remote extraction process. Native matching, JVM work and Flix processing are not individually timed here. Two extraction envelopes lack a process interval.
classes.opportunity: Reuse unchanged file acquisitions. Independent ready worlds may run concurrently; unusually slow files still determine some finishes.

classes.name: Ask structural questions
classes.boundary: Remote Theory process, including its preparation boundary. Not an isolated join timer; remote action scheduling lies outside the process.
classes.opportunity: Prepare answers once for a fixed world. New issues can select from them. Changed worlds require reevaluation under the new identity.

classes.name: Judge a prepared shortlist
classes.tool: Jev · hosted request with Qwen + Atlas ready
classes.boundary: The request only: issue, candidate ranking and structural context already exist. It is not cold end-to-end localization time.
classes.opportunity: Give the model 32 candidates and bounded context. Keep the repository preparation; ask a new judgment for a new issue.

classes.name: Inspect the issue with Sol
classes.boundary: Whole retained inspection turn, including tool interaction. Broader boundary than a Jev request; not a model-kernel latency comparison.
classes.opportunity: This arm leaves repository inspection inside the model-led turn. The comparison does not isolate which individual decomposition causes the difference.

method: Quartiles: linear interpolation at (n-1)*q. Whiskers: furthest observed values within 1.5 IQR. All observations shown; durations calculated in seconds before log display.
population: Separate retained measurement populations. 351 Qwen requests; 90 extraction and 90 Theory processes; 88 Jev requests and 88 Sol turns. Not a shared schedule or an end-to-end timer.
